changes: NodeTrailRequest optional boolean callsOnly; false/omitted retains structural policy. Rust struct literals initialize calls_only.

CLI node --calls-only and MCP get_node calls_only restrict calls throughout role probes, traversal, depth frontier and direction diagnostics. Wrong command, repeated/value-taking CLI flags and nonboolean MCP values fail.
Explicit ask call path from/call chain from syntax uses the same policy and public-ID operands. Existing path-from syntax remains structural. Agent View context retains the call-path question.

Directional search uses existing bounded kind-indexed adjacency. Undirected direction diagnostics charge incident structural records before excluding them; they may exhaust their budget without a complete absence claim.
No extraction, graph/history schema, graph cache or release-version change. Existing ambiguity, heuristic opt-in, stable occurrence IDs and work/response limits remain.

verification.independentOracle: Calls-only added to 729 three-choice four-node DAGs at each of three depth bounds, beside unchanged structural oracles; separate cycle/shortcut/backend/occurrence regressions.
verification.sourceAdjudication: Initial verifier stopped on the new jsoup body route. Source-reviewed after capture; accepted as static reachability only, with no frozen-route or execution-feasibility credit. The stopped verification and original script are preserved.
verification.notRun: No JavaScript, platform matrix, packaging or extraction-fixture rerun: only query/model request and CLI/MCP interfaces changed. No CompassQL grammar/execution change.
verification.warnings: Native logs retain an existing compass-core lib-test unused_mut warning and macOS linker compact-unwind size warnings; no speed claim.

limitations: Known source questions, previously observed graph misses and same-agent source adjudication; no fresh population estimate.

The option is specific to Compass. Graphify public path CLI/shortest_path schemas expose no corresponding relation filter; frozen ID and native-label controls remain separate. Public-neighbor algorithm parity is still outstanding.
Native unscoped names remain ambiguous or missing; never combine the best answer from several workflows into one score.
Redux named function-expression identity remains unresolved; no oracle ID substitution.
The jsoup input graph retains its existing incomplete-coverage diagnostic even when a particular supported path is returned.

The returned jsoup alternative passes through Document.body and its missing-body appendElement fallback, while Cleaner initializes a shell containing a body. Its static call edges are source-supported; execution feasibility in this caller context is unproven and receives no credit.
Static call paths do not imply every branch executes. Source support, confidence, search completeness and global graph completeness remain distinct.
Authored explanations, genuine god-object design judgments, functional community quality and held-out superiority remain unproven.
